recognize_zh: 周邊血淋巴球細胞質內充滿大小一致、邊界清楚的透明空泡（vacuolated lymphocyte），另一顆白血球含粗大深紫色顆粒（類 Alder-Reilly 顆粒），兩者並存提示溶酶體貯積症，本例為 GM1 神經節苷脂貯積症。
features: Small lymphocyte with a rim of cytoplasm packed with multiple discrete, round, clear vacuoles (A)
Lymphocyte nucleus mature with condensed chromatin; vacuoles confined to the cytoplasm
Leukocyte with coarse, dark purple-to-violet cytoplasmic granules and scattered small vacuoles (B), resembling Alder-Reilly-type inclusions
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes), likely artifactual; no parasites or other inclusions
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes with multiple sharply punched-out, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles around a mature nucleus. A second leukocyte contains abundant coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules with interspersed small vacuoles, resembling Alder-Reilly-type granulation. Red cells show crenation, likely a preparation artifact. In a child with neurodevelopmental regression, these vacuolated lymphocytes and abnormal granules are suggestive of a lysosomal storage disorder, consistent with GM1 gangliosidosis; confirmation requires β-galactosidase enzyme assay and GLB1 testing.

ddx.vs: MPS also cause vacuolated lymphocytes and Alder-Reilly granules, so separation relies on urinary glycosaminoglycans and specific enzyme assays rather than morphology.
CLN3 shows striking vacuolated lymphocytes but not coarse granulocytic inclusions, and is confirmed by CLN3 genetic testing.
Toxic granules are finer, confined to neutrophils with Döhle bodies and vacuoles, and occur transiently in sepsis rather than in lymphocytes.
These also produce lymphocyte vacuoles; PAS positivity (Pompe glycogen) or Oil Red O lipid and enzyme assays distinguish them.

captions: Vacuolated lymphocyte with multiple discrete clear cytoplasmic vacuoles
